distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: I ought to say the vehicle is registered to my partner, not to me.
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have the ownership paperwork available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I need to report some damage to my car from this morning.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry to hear that. Was anybody injured?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, thankfully everyone is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like updates by message?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, messages are fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did anybody witness what happened?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One person nearby saw it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the car still driveable?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it drives, but the wing is dented.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the number ending in seven-six-five still yours?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Was another driver involved?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, but they left before I could speak to them.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you need a courtesy car meanwhile?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that would help a lot.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have a preferred repair garage?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, whichever one you recommend.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Whose name is on the ownership paperwork?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I ought to say the vehicle is registered to my partner, not to me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you reported it to the authorities?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I did that this morning.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Where did the incident take place?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: In a supermarket car park.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Lodge the report into the automated assessment run.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will wait to hear back.

claim_progress.not_lodged: the motor claim has not been lodged
claim_progress.assessing: the lodged claim is being assessed
claim_progress.held_for_proof: assessment paused until ownership or vehicle evidence is supplied
claim_progress.settled: the motor claim reached a final accepted settlement

pre_gap_actions.description: Lodge the report into the automated assessment run.
Write the car off before anything has been assessed.
Approve the garage work before the report is lodged.
Chase the bystander for a statement before lodging anything.
Close the report and ask the caller to get in touch later.

post_gap_actions.description: Bring the policy paperwork into line with who legally owns the car.
Put the identical report through the assessment run again now.
Chase the bystander for a statement instead.
Leave the report alone and wait another interval.
Close the report because the assessment interval has passed.

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: Whose name is on the ownership paperwork?

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
